{{Quote|I'll send you to dwell in the Bloodwoods first.|Ku Vrat to Sint Yoru|<ref name="legacy38" />}}
'''Ku Vrat''' was a [[Blood Carver]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was a former member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. He later became employed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Biography==
===Exile===
{{Quote|Ku Vrat, you are a stupid, miserable, blind fool.|[[Nakia Yoru]]|<ref name="legacy38" />}}
Ku Vrat was a [[Blood Carver]] alive over a hundred years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The Blood Carvers were a warrior [[Species/Legends|species]] with a thirst for blood and a reputation for working as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]; Vrat was no exception, becoming a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="legacy38" />

Vrat was dedicated to the hunt, with a penchant for operating by his own rules. However, this proved to be harmful as he killed his brother during a hunt; it was speculated that his brother had become an obstacle in the way of Vrat's quarry. For his crime, Ku Vrat was exiled by his people, and the Bounty Hunters' Guild ultimately followed suit, expelling him for interfering in other hunters' bounties, which was a violation of the [[Bounty Hunters' Creed]].<ref name="legacy38" />

By [[137 ABY]], Vrat had found work with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. He was employed by Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]] as an assassin, operating from Rask's fortress on [[Kaer]], until he was one of Rask's most trusted and capable killers,<ref name="legacy37" /> alongside [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Marriage/Legends|spouses]] [[Sint Yoru|Sint]] and [[Nakia Yoru]].<ref name="legacy38" />

===On the hunt===
{{Quote|May my blade be sharp! May I sculpt a new fate for my enemies!|Ku Vrat|<ref name="legacy40">[[Legacy (2006) 40|''Legacy'' (2006) 40]]</ref>}}
By [[137 ABY]], Vrat, alongside the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] married couple [[Sint Yoru|Sint]] and [[Nakia Yoru]], was tasked by Lun Rask to assassinate both former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and Imperial agent [[Gunn Yage]]. Thanks to information provided by [[Nieve Gromia]], the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], Black Sun pirates had been stealing Imperial shipments for months, but lately Skywalker and his crew began to interfere and take the cargo for themselves, upsetting the deal between Rask and Gromia. Meanwhile, agent Yage was sent by Moff [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] to help Gromia stop the pirates.

Vrat tracked down both targets to [[Gusha]]'s [[Gusha's Luck|Luck]], a cantina in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and set out to kill them, but was prevented from doing so by the Yorus, who reminded him that they had been ordered to be discreet and offered the Blood Carver to work together. Despite not trusting the Anzati couple, Vrat agreed. The three assassins followed Skywalker and Yage to the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and [[Mission to Tatooine (Gunn Yage)|attacked]] them after Skywalker [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking_powers|Force choked]] Yage and caused her [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] to crash. However, the pair managed to escape thanks to a sandstorm. Vrat blamed the Yorus for the targets' escape as they had shot at them without the intent of killing them. Vrat and Sint had a brief fight which was stopped by Nakia, who explained the Blood Carver that once she and her husband got the scent of their prey's [[Soup (Anzati)|luck]], they would be able to track them. She also offered Vrat to take credit for the assassinations as she only cared for feeding on Skywalker's soup.

The trio tracked their targets to the abandoned [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], and a fight ensued, in which Ku Vrat engaged [[Morrigan Corde]] and [[Jariah Syn]], who arrived at the scene. Corde shot Vrat with a poison dart, and then Syn finished him with two [[Nang hul|thud bugs]].
